	disableAntialias             = 1, 
	disableDepth                 = 2, 
	failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat = 3, 
	disablePremultipliedAlpha    = 4, 
	preserveDrawingBuffer        = 5, 
	stencil                      = 6, 
	desynchronized               = 7, 
}

ContextAttributes

ContextAttributes :: distinct bit_set[ContextAttribute; u32]
